entities.summary: Miikka Oliveri Muurinen, is a Finnish professional basketball player for Partizan Belgrade of the Basketball League of Serbia (KLS), the ABA League and the EuroLeague. Nicknamed "Slim Jesus", he is standing at 2.10m tall and holds a wingspan of 220cm.
